name: Desi's Bar & Grill
notes: All 3 photos are branded 'Angry Petes Pizza' (Detroit Deep Dish) rather than 'Desi's Bar & Grill', suggesting Angry Pete's is a food menu/pop-up served inside this bar rather than the bar's own brand - confidence lowered to medium for that mismatch. Photo1 (Motor City Comfort Food) and photo2 (specialty pizza page) share several of the same pizzas under slightly different names (e.g. 'Flaming Hot Cheeto Street Corn Pizza' = 'Hot Cheeto Elote Pizza'); merged to avoid duplicates, keeping photo1's price where the pizza already had an explicit $20 price and otherwise pricing photo2's pizzas at the $20 4-corner pan rate printed at the top of that page. Photo3 is a chalkboard 'special' with a legible price, included as a novelty/limited item; it is not a normal food item.
